decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the firm's core round-the-clock expert support, so its existing service know-how lets it interpret results and refine the offer.
The version management tool builds on the firm's own management tools and in-house development, so the firm can assimilate feedback and keep improving it within its toolset.

A data processing contract generator is a legal-documentation product far from the firm's hosting know-how, which limits its ability to learn from results, and after the GDPR launch wave it offers little strategic fit.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship and lies at the heart of the firm's knowledge base, supported by its own R&D and owned data center capacity.
